title: RFK Jr. Stirred Vaccine Fears in Pennsylvania Years Before Measles Outbreak
summary: At a speech in Lancaster County, Robert F. Kennedy mocked the threat of measles. Now local officials are racing to contain one of the largest outbreaks in the country.
